info.description: Public Polymorfa REST API for sessions, messaging, media, webhooks, campaigns, templates, client tokens, QuickLinks, and bridge routing.

info.title: Polymorfa Console & Management API
info.description:
Complete console/management surface. Resource-oriented REST: `{param}` path variables, single-word action sub-resources.

Namespaces decide inclusion:
- `/platform/…` — **public registry** (279 endpoints): each endpoint declares either a scoped `pmfa_` team key or a verified live dashboard JWT, or dashboard-only authorization when a specific user's authority is required. Only implemented handlers are published to customers and SDKs.
- `/console/…` — **console-only** (125 endpoints): verified dashboard identity. EXCLUDED from the published spec; reason per endpoint.

The published customer spec = this document filtered to `x-audience: public` endpoints with an implemented runtime handler.
Most transitional body/response schemas remain loose (`additionalProperties: true`); session-control operations use explicit strict schemas.

idempotencyParameter.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyParameter.description: Unique key, 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8, that makes this write safe to retry for 1 hour. A retry with the same key, credential, `Polymorfa-Version`, and request never runs the write again while its receipt is retained. Keep the first response. Exact response replay requires authorized replay data; opaque message or campaign bodies are not retained by default. An available exact replay carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Authorization, rate-limit and state refusals (401, 403, 408, 409, 423, 425, 429) are not recorded, so the same key can retry them. Reusing the key for a different request returns `422 idempotency_conflict`. A retry while the original is still running returns `409 idempotency_in_progress`, and a retry after an unrecorded outcome returns `409 idempotency_outcome_unknown`. If the recorded response cannot be read, the retry returns `503 idempotency_replay_unavailable` with `Retry-After` and the write still does not run again.

conversionDeduplication.description:
Beta: requires team enrollment in campaign conversion reporting. Records a conversion your system observed for one campaign recipient, such as a purchase or a sign-up. Name the recipient with `recipientId` from the campaign's recipient list; Polymorfa never matches a conversion to a recipient by phone number, reply or link. The conversion is attributed to the campaign when `occurredAt` is no earlier than the recipient's send time and no more than 7 days after it. Otherwise `attribution.outcome` is `outside_window`, or `not_sent` when the recipient was never sent. A recipient on the team's opt-out list is recorded as `opted_out` without the recipient link or the value. The decision is made once and never recalculated. `eventId` deduplicates per project: sending the same `eventId` with the same details returns the original conversion with `replayed: true`; different details answer `422 idempotency_conflict`. `value` is an integer amount in the currency's minor unit (for example cents) and an ISO 4217 code; amounts are never converted between currencies. Values are reported by you and are not verified payments. `occurredAt` cannot be in the future or more than 90 days ago. Conversions are deleted 400 days after they are recorded. Send `projectId` in the body when using a team API key.

Requires `campaigns:manage`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.
